entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. Order number is 774-B219-PULSE.

Okay, I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 19th. That makes it 27 days ago. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just not for me. Look, I tried to do this online over two weeks ago, on day 9, but your whole system was down.
I see. So you're saying you encountered a website error when you attempted the return?
A major one. The page wouldn't load, and I couldn't print the return label. I have a screenshot of the error message if you need proof.
No, that won't be necessary. Let me check our system status for that period... Yes, I am seeing a log of a known service outage around that time. My apologies for that inconvenience.
Let me just confirm our return policy here for you. One moment.

Okay, I've got it. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery for items in their original condition. Since you're at day 27, you're well within the window. I can go ahead and process this return for you immediately.
Good. Just send the label to the email you have on file.

Of course. I've just sent the pre-paid return label to your email. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off with the carrier. You'll receive a full refund once it's processed at our warehouse. Is there anything else I can assist with?
